scope: Author-side page, figure and layout review by AI agents (Claude in OpenCode); not independent human refereeing.
method: Every page rendered at 100 dpi by editorial/render_review.py and viewed on the four-page contact sheets; every page whose body pixels differ from all pages of the 13 September PDF (classification by visual_pages.py: the article without its running-head band y<110 px, the companion without its footer band y>=1095 px) viewed at full rendered size; the excluded bands (page numbers, running heads, edition date) viewed on the contact sheets and on header and footer strips (visual_strips.py).

visual_findings: Viewed all 13 contact sheets, the 48 changed pages at full size (150-dpi zooms where formulas were dense, 13 September pages where wording changed) plus p. 10 on its sheet, and all 7 header strips: date on p. 1 reads 'Author-review edition, 15 October 2026', running heads and page numbers consistent, no ?? or clipped/overfull text, floats and cross-references in place; 0 blocking and 15 cosmetic defects: 2x2 matrices with ~3pt column gaps (pp. 26, 35, 38, 44), Fig. 3 inset labels on box edges (p. 32), Fig. 1(b) origin label crossed by the axis (p. 4), number of display (19) on its own line (p. 24), set I_0 split across lines (p. 18), full-width display (p. 20), missing indent after a proof (p. 28), cramped display (p. 44), loose lines in edited wording (pp. 20, 38, 41, 42); most are unchanged since 13 September.
summary: Article: all 49 pages viewed on 13 contact sheets and 48 pages at full size (every page whose body changed since 13 September: 48); 15 cosmetic findings, none blocking.
